name: Untere Issalm
beschreibung: The Untere Issalm is located in the district of Kufstein in Tirol, nestled in an alpine pasture landscape at about 1,000 meters above sea level. The building is a former alpine hut that is used as a youth hostel and offers simple, functional overnight accommodation. The atmosphere is quiet and rural – suitable for hikers and groups who want to enjoy the mountain nature. Guests can expect multi-bed rooms, a shared kitchen, and a small lounge area. The nearest town with shopping facilities is in the valley.
